description: supabase-security config. Copy to .supa360.json in your project root (it is gitignored — it names real project refs, never commit it). Two independent sections: (1) ref protection — permanent_blocked_refs are refs that can NEVER be remediated or used as a lab under any flag or env combination (PUT PRODUCTION HERE), blocked_refs are disposable lab projects, blocked by default but unblockable via SUPA360_LAB_REF plus --i-understand-this-is-destructive. Both are UNIONed with the SUPA360_PERMANENT_BLOCKED_REFS / SUPA360_BLOCKED_REFS env vars. A malformed file is a hard error, never a silent loss of protection. (2) suppressions — each entry suppresses a finding whose target matches; the finding still appears in output (auditable) with suppressed=true, but is excluded from fail-gate counts. An optional 'check' field narrows the suppression to one check.
